notes: The value of the top-level workflow: key, not a whole state file. grammar_version 99, an unknown root key (scheduler) and unknown node keys (budget_used, substrate) must degrade rather than error. Every nodes entry is still one line, which is the text-level E2 rule the runner checks separately, and the suspended node status is exercised here. version-99-state.yml carries schema null on purpose: a document that declares a newer format cannot validate against the v1 const, and the expectation is the runner reporting degraded: newer-format rather than a schema pass.
